summary: Main road kerb by a junction; bank and trees beside it, no parking.
reasons: Collector road, no parked cars here
Grass bank, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: No buildings, with bush and a creek bank behind. The road is open to view of passing traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs against a grassy bank with a footpath and signal pole; no pull-off before the dirt patch further east.
drivers.traffic: Busy Witton Road with multiple lanes and a roundabout at the west end.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this stretch; the two cars in the QLD image are on a dirt pull-off beyond it.

flags: Low-lying: 3.4 m, Witton Creek 12 m away, flood-prone
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy to the north; open to the south.
